title: The River Incident
summary: Lynleit struggles beneath the river, reaches its surface, and encounters the girl in the fish dress.

beats.title: The girl in the fish dress

panels.label: Sketch 1
panels.title: Beneath the surface
panels.alt: Lynleit reaches upward underwater while hands grip her thighs and tall laced boots. Her hair floats above her; insets show her eye and the hands gripping a boot.

panels.label: Sketch 2
panels.title: Reaching through the water
panels.alt: A second pencil composition of Lynleit underwater, reaching toward the viewer as hands hold her legs. A boot close-up sits in the lower right.

panels.label: Sketch 3
panels.title: Flame underwater
panels.alt: Blue flame surrounds Lynleit's hand as she grips an attacking arm underwater. Other submerged hands still clutch her tall boots; bubbles rise toward the surface.

panels.label: Sketch 4
panels.title: The surface holds
panels.alt: Lynleit braces her palm and boots on the river surface. Her wet hair hangs forward and ripples spread beneath each point of contact.

panels.label: Sketch 5
panels.title: The girl in the fish dress
panels.alt: A long-haired girl stands on the river in a dress of dead fish, her head tilted. Insets show her sewn-shut eyelids and the fish and scales forming her dress.

panels.label: Sketch 6
panels.title: The sewn eyelids
panels.alt: An alternative composition of the girl in a dead-fish dress reaching forward. Insets show her stitched eyelids and a hand touching the river, with fish and silhouette studies to the left.
